name: Odensvi - Dalhem - Björndalen, Tjustleden etapp 7
description: Odensvi / Kyrksjön to Björndalen / Stora Vrången. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Risebo camping water: Relevant only if the Risebo connector is modeled.
notes: Verify exact Dalhem church drinking-water tap coordinate, accessibility, and seasonality.
Confirm current opening/operation for Odensvi lanthandel/cafe/lodging/camping before modeling them as access services.
Confirm Risebo connector marking/currentness and whether OSM relation 8421040 should be normalized as a separate connector.
Run import-grade Stora Vrången reserve and water-protection-area polygon overlays.
Check KLT line 29/30 journeys for intended travel date and decide whether Lilla Dalhem, Dalhem kyrka, and Odensviholm are practical enough for app access copy.
Verify legal/public parking at Kyrksjön, Dalhem, and Björndalen/Stora Vrången; none was confirmed by official sources.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Kyrksjön
facilities.description: Start shelter at the Section 6/7 handoff in the northwestern part of Kyrksjön. Facility coordinate is about 92.6 m east of the official GPX start point but on the route/facility cluster.

facilities.name: Kyrksjön toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the Kyrksjön shelter/start cluster. OSM tags drinking_water=no; do not model as drinking water.

facilities.name: Kyrksjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace associated with the Kyrksjön shelter. No firewood availability confirmed. Apply current fire bans and any local restrictions.

facilities.name: Odensvi lanthandel
facilities.description: Off-route Odensvi village shop/service near the start side. Current opening hours/service status not verified. Keep as off-route access context, not on-trail facility.

facilities.name: Odensvi Campingplats
facilities.description: Off-route campsite at Odensvi/Kyrksjön, useful for start-side planning. Paid/customer site. Current operation and access rules need verification.

facilities.name: Odensvi - Kyrksjön bathing area
facilities.description: Off-route bathing area in Odensvi village on Kyrksjön. Off main route; do not imply potable water or lifeguarded swimming.

facilities.name: Rånestad livestock detour decision point
facilities.description: Approximate decision area for taking road via Rånestad to avoid cattle near Tynn. Import as a warning/variant note only. Exact variant geometry was not found.

facilities.name: Tynn outlet bathing point

facilities.name: Tynn viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint where the route gives a final view over Tynn before continuing toward Holmsjön. Merge nearby Naturkartan/OSM variants if normalizing POIs.

facilities.name: Holmsjön - Ticka, ArkNat
facilities.description: ArkNat 2023 shelter Ticka by Holmsjön, near the halfway point of the official section. No toilet or potable water confirmed. OSM indicates fireplace; apply fire-ban/reserve rules as relevant.

facilities.name: Holmsjön bathing point
facilities.description: Natural lake bathing near Ticka at Holmsjön. Natural lake water only; do not model as potable.

facilities.name: Dalhem church

facilities.name: Karlsberg connector toward Risebo

facilities.name: Larum hillfort / Skänskullen

facilities.name: Larum / Stora Vrången viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint associated with the Larum/Skänskullen side path before Björndalen. Likely should be merged with Larum hillfort / Skänskullen.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Björndalen

facilities.name: Björndalen toilet

Use as rules/protected-area metadata rather than a point facility. Representative coordinate is not the polygon intersection; run polygon overlay before import.
